subject_session: Achilles/Achilles_10252013 (example); pooled over 5 linear-track sessions, 4 rats

headline_stat.name: median Bayesian decoding error (0.25 s bins) vs chance

stated_limitation: Because the linearization used here assumes a straight track, the analysis is scoped to the five linear-track sessions, which together contribute 348 pyramidal cells and 82 interneurons.

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 (Grosmark & Buzsáki CA1) is the canonical linear-track place-cell dataset in the exact species, region, and paradigm expected.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via LINDI with correct, explicitly validated handling of two genuine NWB quirks and defensible unit/quality/speed filtering.
justification.analysis: Skaggs information against a circular-shift null, split-half stability, cross-validated Bayesian decoding, and a Poisson GLM to dissociate position from speed together form a correct and complete treatment.
justification.correctness: Reported numbers reproduce from the committed code (CSV sums to 232/348 matching the 67% claim; decoding 4.9 vs 58 cm matches fig05), are internally consistent, and are statistically sound.
justification.figures: Figures clearly show restricted directional fields, a clean population diagonal, near-perfect decoding (r=0.96), and GLM-vs-binned agreement, with units, sample sizes, and unflattering example selection.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate to a genuinely strong result, and the write-up names its scoping limitation and explicitly states what the interneuron and GLM controls rule out.
